project.name: Closed and open four-to-five-to-six channel transitions (NS38)
project.subtitle: The static L=6, K=3 table follows one closed singlet and two open J=3 sources on ring and complete graphs. A direct four-to-six hop vanishes, while the selected witnesses have explicit four-to-five-to-six matrix elements. Size controls show when five- and six-active sectors exist.

runs.description: Closed and open four-to-five-to-six channel transitions (NS38)

assessment.summary: The static L=6, K=3 table follows one closed singlet and two open J=3 sources on ring and complete graphs. A direct four-to-six hop vanishes, while the selected witnesses have explicit four-to-five-to-six matrix elements. Size controls show when five- and six-active sectors exist.
assessment.recordedStudyStatus: 99 independent witness comparisons; maximum residual 1.99e-15; 67 regression tests passed in the research session
